title: Two jobs on a pool of four slots
recordedWith: slot 0.1.0 built from source, slot serve --tokens 4 --http off

entries.comment: A go job holds 4 slots, and go's -p is set to what it holds.
Another shell's go job holds all 4 slots of this pool. This job queues, runs when a slot is free, and keeps its exit code.
